ana: Heads-up PR #4620: fixes for label examples, autoscale field names, and a clearer SLA sentence. quick review pls: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620
kevin: skim looks good. two quick notes: TF provider expects `labels = {"redwood.tenant" = "acme"}` not `label = "tenant:acme"`. can you add both old/new examples?
ryan: infra echo: add `tools/labels_to_reserved_pool.py` link and a sample `terraform plan` snippet showing the changed reserved_pool tag.
tara: nit: autoscale field should be `cooldown_seconds` in examples. also prefer namespaced labels in new examples.
ana: thanks all, will update and push. doc-bot: PR #4620 added reviewers @kevin @ryan @tara. run `make docs-test` before merge.
